recreation_brief.assembly_notes: Image-first build (no video credits): (1) base = one hero still of the WaveX talking-head subject, held for the whole clip with a slow Ken Burns push-in. (2) Overlay the climbing view-counter (0 -> target) as the retention hook for the first 3s — animate as a number graphic, no video needed. (3) Punch in each FORMAT name as a white word-graphic on the beat (~1/sec), 19-20 of them, pulled from the wavex format taxonomy. (4) For ~6 marquee formats, pop a small inset 'demo' still (a generated 9:16 image standing in for that format) with its label. (5) VO from the text-to-speech skill reading the format list fast; light beat bed + tick SFX on each word. (6) Outro CTA still 'which ones do you use? -> save this'. If Higgsfield credits return, the only place a 1-2s clip helps is the inset demos — everything else stays stills.
